title: Cascata
subtitle: Three strands of diamond crossing at the throat, gathering to a single stone.

stone.origin: Natural. Single 9 ct F/VVS center; strand diamonds G-H/VS, graduated 0.15 ct (near clasp) to 0.45 ct (center crossing). GIA certified.

description: Three platinum strands of graduated round brilliants weave and cross at the throat, then draw down to a single larger diamond resting at the sternum. The strands are graduated deliberately — smaller near the clasp, opening toward the centre — so the whole piece reads as a cascade caught mid-fall, motion held in metal. It is a one-of-a-kind necklace, its brilliance concentrated where the eye naturally settles. Polished platinum keeps the light cool and continuous from the first strand to the last.
